import json
from cart import total
cases = ((20000, 5000, 18000), (10000, 15000, 3000))
rows = [dict(subtotal=s, coupon=c, expected=e, actual=total(s, c)) for s,c,e in cases]
print(json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(r['actual'] == r['expected'] for r in rows) else 1)

import json
from cart import total
cases = ((50000, 0, 50000), (60000, 20000, 40000), (45000, 0, 48000))
rows = [dict(subtotal=s, coupon=c, expected=e, actual=total(s, c)) for s,c,e in cases]
print(json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(r['actual'] == r['expected'] for r in rows) else 1)

def shipping_fee(subtotal):
    return 0 if subtotal >= 50000 else 3000
